name: Cherry Blossom Chaos

date.source: The board's own post date of the broadcast's first part.

matches.finish: Jeff Jorgenson pinned Pat Gordon Jr with a superkick followed by a leg hook for the three count, which Gordon broke up too late; Jorgenson had pulled the robe Gordon wore over his head as he was getting into the ring and landed a kneelift on the covered head. It was the first match won in the fed's new run.

Donovan Astros won when the referee called for the bell on his Martyr's Cross with Willard, his left arm hurt after a shoulder block into the ring post, begging the referee not to stop it; the commentators did not think Willard had given up. Willard had locked on the Camel Clutch and hit a belly to belly suplex earlier, and The Freak walked to the ring with him.
King Krusher and Striker won the NGEN World Tag Titles when Striker pinned Cameron Cruise after Problem Child screwed Cruise, as its founder tells the result in his post of 12 January 2011.
matches.stipulation: Match for the vacant NGEN World Tag Titles, the WFW World Tag Champions against the challengers
matches.title: ngen-2010-world-tag-team

matches.finish: Minion pinned Golem in the Pills on a Pole match, as its founder tells the result in his post of 12 January 2011.

Jared Wells kept the title: after Jesse Ramey's two Darkness Busters (Wells got a shoulder up just before three each time) and a leg lock Wells broke with a kick to the mouth, Wells Rage Bombed him off the top rope, both men were out cold, and at nine Wells' arm flopped across Ramey's chest for the three count. Earlier Ramey had worked over Wells' knee and Wells had caught him off the turnbuckle and powerslammed him through the announcing table.
matches.stipulation: BAD World Heavyweight Title match under BAD rules, anything goes
matches.title: ngen-2010-bad-world-heavyweight

matches.finish: HAL won the vacant NGEN North American Title by pinning Psycho, the last man he faced, as its founder tells the result in his post of 12 January 2011.
matches.stipulation: Falls Count Anywhere on the Mall elimination match for the vacant NGEN North American Title
matches.title: ngen-2010-north-american

matches.finish: Shawn Hart beat Felix Red to become the first NGEN World Heavyweight Champion, as its founder tells the result in his post of 12 January 2011.
matches.stipulation: Match for the vacant NGEN World Heavyweight Title, the WFW World Heavyweight Champion against the number one contender
matches.title: ngen-2010-world-heavyweight

notes: The fed's first pay-per-view, announced on 20 January 2010 for Washington, D.C., with the match folders opened on 22 February and an RP deadline of 8 March; the broadcast was posted from 10 May 2010 by its founder, with Brandon Jacobs, Jonathan Marx and Vic Waters at the table, and a part for the BAD World Heavyweight Title match was posted on 21 May. Only the opening, the first two matches and the BAD title match were posted as broadcast parts. Its founder's post of 12 January 2011 gives the results of the other four matches (the NGEN World Tag Titles, the Pills on a Pole match, the North American elimination match and the World Heavyweight main event) and those results are recorded from that post; he retired from running leagues the day before. A roleplay posted on 13 April 2010 pictures Problem Child and Cameron Cruise with the NGEN tag belts, a month before the broadcast was posted.
